"EMERALD MINE 9X" has one of ten top prizes left and is close to selling out. Most of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Every line of EMERALD MINE 9X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5055.headline: How far along this game is

5057.body:
The most common win left on "EASY MONEY" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and two of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The numbers for "EASY MONEY" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5057.headline: What the prize table shows

5059.body:
The most common win left on "THE CASH WHEEL" is $6. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and 30 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If you play "THE CASH WHEEL" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5059.headline: What's actually left to win

5060.body:
"FIND THE 7S" is near the end of its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a smaller share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a reason to be careful.

Tomorrow's count on "FIND THE 7S" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
5060.headline: Tickets sold so far

5063.body:
The top prize count on "CA$H IN HAND" has not moved for over a month. The game still has two of four top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.
